description: Ministry of  Mahaweli Development and Environment - Order to prohibit the manufacture of any bag of high density (Grocery Bag)
reasoning: This gazette content constitutes a legal/regulatory order issued by the President under the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980. It prohibits specific activities (manufacture and sale of certain polyethylene bags) and exempts certain items, establishing regulatory requirements and compliance rules. While the President is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about exercising statutory powers to create environmental regulations, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
